home-heroSubtitle: Hi! I'm Maxime Bartier. A senior full stack developer with :years+ years of experience building high-performance, custom web applications.
home-aboutTitle: Co-founder, developer, teacher — :years years building web products that truly serve their users.
home-aboutText:
Since 2017, I've been designing and building custom web applications through ArkDevel, the company I co-founded. From business back-offices to real-time dashboards, I own the full product cycle — architecture, API, database, UI, deployment.

Along the way, I maintained the Qwerteach SaaS platform for 8 years, modernized IT tooling at leTEC (public transport), and built budget and carbon tracking solutions for film production at TheGreenShot. I also spent years teaching — 3 schools, 10-month bootcamps, diverse audiences — which taught me to communicate clearly and help teams grow.

Today I use AI daily in my workflow (Claude Code, Copilot) with a TDD approach. Self-driven, product-minded, at home in small teams where every technical decision has real impact.
